summary: Complaints centre on wild animal and flood safety, forest department action over crops, and unpaid sugarcane dues, while appreciation is limited to the new Vande Bharat stop at Najibabad.

positives.english: A Vande Bharat train now stops at Najibabad, making travel easier.
positives.hindi: नजीबाबाद में वंदे भारत रुकने लगी, अब सफर आसान है
positives.basis: Dehradun-Lucknow Vande Bharat Express now halts at Najibabad Junction, flagged off by Uttarakhand Assembly Speaker Ritu Khanduri; the article says hill residents, who earlier had to go to Haridwar, benefit.

positives.english: Nagina's wood craft keeps many artisan families in work.
positives.hindi: * नगीना की लकड़ी की नक्काशी से कई कारीगर परिवारों का काम चलता है
positives.basis: Inference: no Najibabad-specific positive source found. Gaon Connection's 'Gaon Se' story is on Nagina (a different AC, reserved SC, in Bijnor district) and says the craft dates to the 18th century, supports many artisan families and is gaining international recognition. The page shows no publication date.

positives.english: A women's self-help group in Bijnor is getting export orders for its herbal tea.
positives.hindi: * बिजनौर की महिलाओं की हर्बल चाय अब विदेश तक पहुंच रही है
positives.basis: Inference: district-level, not Najibabad-specific. Gaon Connection headline says the herbal tea, started with a Rs 1 lakh loan, is getting orders from abroad (America and Europe per the article URL). The page shows no publication date.

positives.english: Senior officials came to the spot when a leopard attack caused a protest.
positives.hindi: गुलदार के मामले में एसडीएम और सीओ मौके पर पहुंचे
positives.basis: After the 10 Sep 2026 leopard killing at Alopur village, SDM Shailendra Kumar Singh, CO Sunil Kumar Singh and Deputy Ranger Ramkumar reached the spot and tried to calm the situation. This is one incident, not a general pattern.

positives.english: The municipal council held a Tiranga Yatra through the town with students taking part.
positives.hindi: नगर पालिका ने तिरंगा यात्रा निकाली, छात्रों में देशभक्ति का जोश
positives.basis: Najibabad municipal council held a Tiranga Yatra led by the SDM, council chairman and executive officer; the headline says students raised patriotic slogans. A civic event, low impact on daily services.

negatives.english: Leopard attacks keep happening and the forest department does nothing.
negatives.hindi: गुलदार आता है, जान जाती है, वन विभाग कुछ नहीं करता
negatives.basis: Alopur village (Jalalabad area, Bijnor district): a 40-year-old woman, Babita Devi, was taken by a leopard around 6 a.m. on 10 Sep 2026 and found dead in a sugarcane field about 300 m away. Villagers sat with the body and refused to lift it until a case was filed against forest staff. BKU workers blocked the Double Phatak flyover in Najibabad, demanding action for repeated attacks and asking for the leopard to be caught.

negatives.english: Every heavy rain floods our lanes and houses.
negatives.hindi: बारिश हुई तो मोहल्ले की गलियां और घर पानी में डूब जाते हैं
negatives.basis: Rain of 4 Aug 2025 in Najibabad: in Mohalla Mughlushah and Maqbara area, access roads and homes had 'two to three feet' of water; dozens of houses were flooded near the Thatheron wali masjid area; Ajmal Khan Road was heavily waterlogged; students had trouble reaching school.

negatives.english: The forest department destroyed our crops and did not let us harvest.
negatives.hindi: वन विभाग ने खेत उजाड़ दिए, फसल काटने भी नहीं दी
negatives.basis: 9 Jan 2026: hundreds of Bharatiya Kisan Union (Tikait) farmers marched on foot with sugarcane in hand from the Bijnor DFO office to the tehsil compound in Najibabad. They alleged the forest department destroyed their crop and did not allow the rest to be harvested, and demanded withdrawal of a case against farmers, revenue land and the remaining crop. District-level (Bijnor DFO), not AC-only.

negatives.english: Sugarcane payments from the mills stay stuck for years and the mills keep delaying.
negatives.hindi: * गन्ने का पैसा सालों से अटका है, मिलें टालती रहती हैं
negatives.basis: Inference: no Najibabad or Bijnor cane-dues report from 2024-26 was found. Statewide, Gaon Connection reports mills owe farmers Rs 6,480 crore and a promised 31 August payment deadline was missed (page undated). The only Bijnor-specific report found is Quint (27 Sep 2019): about nine mills owed farmers 'Rs 500 crore' unpaid 'since 2018'. Old and not confirmed for the present.

negatives.english: The Ganga keeps eating farmland and moving toward the village at Gauspur.
negatives.hindi: गंगा हमारी जमीन काट रही है, कटान रोकने के इंतजाम अधूरे हैं
negatives.basis: Gauspur village (Nangalsoti area, Najibabad): in one month the Ganga eroded 20 m toward the settlement and cut another 2-3 m after rain; crops of nine named farmers were lost; villagers say the anti-erosion studs are few, incomplete and not working. This is a 2021 report, the most recent Najibabad erosion report found; no 2024-26 report was found.

notes: Research was limited: the WebSearch budget ran out after about 18 searches, so Hindi local coverage is thinner than the brief asks for. Field-check before use. (1) Identity confirmed from Wikipedia: AC No. 17, Najibabad, Bijnor district, reserved status None, current MLA Tasleem Ahmad (SP). Nagina AC is a different seat (SC-reserved). (2) Sugarcane dues (negative 4) is an inference; no local 2024-26 source was found. The Gaon Connection and Quint pages are not dated or are old. (3) Ganga erosion (negative 5) relies on a 2021 report; check whether it is still active. (4) Positives 2 and 3 are district-level or Nagina-level, not Najibabad-specific, and are flagged as inference. Positive 4 covers one incident. (5) Not used: the Kamal Nath land-record story (9 Oct 2026, Amikhanpur village) because it is a private land-fraud case with named individuals, not a broad voter issue. Not used: Gramin Bank fire, Kathara market fire (May 2026), Bijnor handloom weavers and the Ganga boat capsize (Bijnor district, dates not shown). Also, the Najibabad Amar Ujala tag page had no 2025-26 local service or water items. Field check suggested: drainage and waterlogging in Mughlushah and Maqbara, Double Phatak traffic, power supply, and cane arrears at mills serving Najibabad.
